lines.t: You broke my chains with a single word
Lit up my darkness, my soul was stirred
I was thirsty, running dry
You poured out rivers from the sky
No more hiding, I've been found
Your love lifts me off the ground
I'm dancing in the light
I'm singing in your name
Joy overflows, I'm alive with you
With every step my heart ignites
You are my glory, you are my delight
I'm dancing in the light, the light
When my hope was hanging by a thread
You called me higher, lifted my head
With every laugh and every tear
I rejoice because you are near
You turn my morning into song
With you beside me I belong
I'm dancing in the light
I'm singing your name
Joy overflows, I'm alive again
With every step my heart ignites
You are my glory, you are my delight
I'm dancing in the light
Alive, alive in the love tonight
